articles.summary: Transaction marks another milestone in Penguin’s transformation into a pure-play data center AI infrastructure solutions company Penguin Solutions, Inc. (“Penguin Solutions,” “Penguin,” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: PENG), the AI Factory Platform Company, today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to sell its Cree LED business (“Cree LED”) to Transom Capital Group (“Transom”), a leading operations-focused middle-market private equity firm. The planned divestiture reflects Penguin Solutions’ commitment to creating long-term shareholder value. It will further align the Company’s portfolio, resources, and capital allocation priorities with the significant growth opportunities it sees in data center AI infrastructure and memory. articles.summary: New memory modules accelerate data throughput and offer optional Zefr® testing for enhanced reliability in demanding AI workloads Penguin Solutions , Inc. (Nasdaq: PENG ), the AI Factory Platform Company, today announced its newest SMART Modular DDR5 Multi-Ranked Dual In-line Memory Module (MRDIMM), expanding its portfolio of memory solutions designed for AI data centers. Running at industry-leading DDR5-12800 speeds, these new MRDIMMs address growing bandwidth demand created by the exponential growth in AI inference and agentic AI workloads. Demonstrating Penguin’s expertise at the intersection of data center AI infrastructure and memory solutions, the SMART Modular MRDIMMs include industry-leading thermal and electrical protections and utilize an innovative architecture that multiplexes two physical ranks into a single logical rank to avoid traditional speed limitations.
